newsitem.title: LEBANON: Three Israeli soldiers killed in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Three Israeli soldiers killed in south Lebanon.

text.p: Three Israeli soldiers were killed and one seriously wounded when a roadside bomb exploded in their patrol in south Lebanon overnight, pro-Israeli militia sources said on Thursday.
The attack targeted the foot patrol in the Shoumariyyeh area in the central sector of Israel' south Lebanon occupation zone, the South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia sources said.
Earlier the SLA sources said four Israeli soldiers were wounded, three of them seriously, in the attack.
In Beirut, the pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) claimed responsibility for the bomb blast.
On Wednesday, Israeli planes rocketed suspected Hizbollah guerrilla targets in Iqlim al-Toufah ridge north of the Israeli-held zone but no one was hurt.

Hizbollah is fighting to oust some 1,000 Israeli troops and the 3,000-strong allied SLA militia holding the south Lebanon zone set up by Israel in 1985 to protect its northern border from guerrilla raids.
